test_title: PYST 33: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The GST Council has scraped how much percentage tax on all individual life and health insurance policies, effective 22 September 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**18%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **GST Council**, in a landmark decision, has decided to scrap the **18%** Goods and Services Tax (GST) previously levied on **individual life and health insurance** policies.
 
• This decision is set to become effective from **September 22, 2025**, aiming to provide financial relief to millions of policyholders across **India**.
 
• The move specifically targets **individual health insurance** premiums and **term life insurance** policies, ensuring that essential social security remains affordable for the common man.
 
• This policy change was recommended during the **54th GST Council Meeting**, chaired by the **Union Finance Minister**, **Nirmala Sitharaman**, following extensive deliberations by a **Group of Ministers (GoM)** on insurance rate rationalization.
 
• By removing the **18%** tax burden, the government intends to boost **insurance penetration** in the country, which is currently lower than the global average.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is 18%.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **GST Council and Constitution**: 
 
 
• The **GST Council** is a constitutional body established under **Article 279A** of the **Indian Constitution**.
 
• It is chaired by the **Union Finance Minister** and includes the **Union Minister of State** in charge of Revenue or Finance and Ministers in charge of Finance or Taxation of all **States**.
 
 
 
• **Significance for Senior Citizens**: 
 
 
• One of the primary beneficiaries of this exemption will be **senior citizens**, who often face high premium costs due to age-related risks. The removal of the **18%** tax significantly lowers their annual out-of-pocket expenditure.
 
 
 
• **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)**: 
 
 
• The **IRDAI**, established in **1999**, has been working towards the vision of "**Insurance for All by 2047**." Tax exemptions on premiums are seen as a critical step toward achieving this objective.
 
 
 
• **Tax Slabs in GST**: 
 
 
• Currently, **India** follows a multi-tiered tax structure for GST with slabs of **5%**, **12%**, **18%**, and **28%**. Essential services and certain food items are often placed in the **0%** (exempt) category to protect vulnerable sections of society.
 
 
 
• **Health and Life Insurance Types**: 
 
 
• **Term Insurance**: Provides pure life cover without any savings or profits component; the scraping of tax makes this primary safety net cheaper.
 
• **Health Insurance**: Covers medical expenses; the exemption is expected to encourage more individuals to opt for higher coverage amounts, such as **Rs. 5 lakh** or more, without worrying about tax inflation on the premium.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Financial Impact**: The removal of the **18%** tax is expected to result in a revenue foregone of several thousand **crores** for the government, but it is expected to be offset by the increased volume of insurance buyers.
 
• **Implementation Date**: The specific effective date of **September 22, 2025**, provides insurance companies and the **GST Network (GSTN)** sufficient time to recalibrate their systems for premium calculations.
 
• **GoM (Group of Ministers)**: The Bihar Deputy Chief Minister **Samrat Choudhary** led the **GoM** that looked into the details of these tax exemptions before the final council decision.
</ul
